name: Mihara Futoshi
source:
Father of the protagonist Tomokazu.

He had been in distress for a long time after losing his wife before Tomokazu and his wife Maho decided to move in and live with him.

Thanks to Maho, he already recovered but started to hold sexual desire toward her.

He has strong sex drive and rich skills accumulated from many relationships in the past.
